svg.title: Components and failure domains
svg.desc: Component diagram, dark theme. The Discord gateway websocket feeds a gateway listener, which is a resident process on operator-controlled hardware forming failure domain A. It feeds a Cloudflare Worker forming failure domain B, which handles interaction handling, classification, enforcement and a scheduled sweep, and writes to two D1 databases: BOT_DB holding guild-local state and VM_DB holding the moderation record. The domains fail independently: a worker deploy does not drop the gateway session and a gateway reconnect does not interrupt interaction handling. Both databases contain a table named mod_log, so reading the wrong one returns a plausible empty answer rather than an error. Contrast computed from hex: text 13.85 to 1. No animation.

svg.text: Three cooperating pieces, deliberately split across two failure domains that fail independently.
